zh: 防晒衣项目演示快照：12 位候选达人已完成筛选，9 位确认佣金与档期；另 3 位待回复，9/15 上午收口合作清单。
en: Sun-protection campaign demo snapshot: 12 creator candidates screened; 9 confirmed commission and availability. The other 3 replies are pending, with the partnership list closing on the morning of 9/15.

zh: 演示交付节点：12 位候选达人已完成筛选，9 位确认佣金与档期；另 3 位待回复，9/15 上午收口合作清单。
en: Demo delivery milestone: 12 creator candidates screened; 9 confirmed commission and availability. The other 3 replies are pending, with the partnership list closing on the morning of 9/15.

zh: 防晒衣项目演示快照：卖点清单和 4 条脚本初稿已齐，2 条素材通过内部核对；剩余素材补拍及敏感表达修改约在 9/15 上午完成。
en: Sun-protection campaign demo snapshot: Selling points and 4 draft scripts are ready; 2 assets passed internal checks. Remaining reshoots and sensitive wording revisions should finish on the morning of 9/15.

zh: 演示交付节点：卖点清单和 4 条脚本初稿已齐，2 条素材通过内部核对；剩余素材补拍及敏感表达修改约在 9/15 上午完成。
en: Demo delivery milestone: Selling points and 4 draft scripts are ready; 2 assets passed internal checks. Remaining reshoots and sensitive wording revisions should finish on the morning of 9/15.

zh: 防晒衣项目演示快照：直播流程与场控分工已出稿，完成设备联调；尚待正式彩排和 9/15 上线执行，不能把准备完成视为直播已完成。
en: Sun-protection campaign demo snapshot: The livestream run of show and stage roles are drafted, and equipment integration is complete. Formal rehearsal and the 9/15 broadcast remain; readiness does not mean the broadcast is complete.

zh: 演示交付节点：直播流程与场控分工已出稿，完成设备联调；尚待正式彩排和 9/15 上线执行，不能把准备完成视为直播已完成。
en: Demo delivery milestone: The livestream run of show and stage roles are drafted, and equipment integration is complete. Formal rehearsal and the 9/15 broadcast remain; readiness does not mean the broadcast is complete.

zh: 防晒衣项目演示快照：价格、赠品和可售库存已核对，仓库待签回履约时效与缺货替代方案，预计 9/15 上午确认。
en: Sun-protection campaign demo snapshot: Pricing, gifts, and sellable inventory are checked. Warehouse sign-off on fulfillment times and stockout alternatives is expected on the morning of 9/15.

zh: 演示交付节点：价格、赠品和可售库存已核对，仓库待签回履约时效与缺货替代方案，预计 9/15 上午确认。
en: Demo delivery milestone: Pricing, gifts, and sellable inventory are checked. Warehouse sign-off on fulfillment times and stockout alternatives is expected on the morning of 9/15.

zh: 防晒衣项目演示快照：预算分配与人群包已准备，待终版素材入库后完成广告审核和首轮投放检查，预计 9/15 完成。
en: Sun-protection campaign demo snapshot: Budget allocations and audience segments are ready. Final assets must arrive before ad review and first-round campaign checks, expected on 9/15.

zh: 演示交付节点：预算分配与人群包已准备，待终版素材入库后完成广告审核和首轮投放检查，预计 9/15 完成。
en: Demo delivery milestone: Budget allocations and audience segments are ready. Final assets must arrive before ad review and first-round campaign checks, expected on 9/15.

zh: 防晒衣项目演示快照：GMV 口径与归因字段已对齐，看板框架已建；上线后的成交与退款数据尚未产生，复盘预计 9/16 收口。
en: Sun-protection campaign demo snapshot: GMV definitions and attribution fields are aligned, and the dashboard framework is built. Post-launch sales and refund data do not exist yet; the review is expected to close on 9/16.

zh: 演示交付节点：GMV 口径与归因字段已对齐，看板框架已建；上线后的成交与退款数据尚未产生，复盘预计 9/16 收口。
en: Demo delivery milestone: GMV definitions and attribution fields are aligned, and the dashboard framework is built. Post-launch sales and refund data do not exist yet; the review is expected to close on 9/16.

zh: 防晒衣项目演示快照：合同模板与已到素材完成首轮审核；仍有 2 处防晒宣称需补证明，预计 9/15 上午完成复核。
en: Sun-protection campaign demo snapshot: Contract templates and received assets passed initial review. Two sun-protection claims still need evidence, with rechecks expected on the morning of 9/15.

en: Sun-protection campaign historical example: Received assets passed initial review; claims evidence still needed.

zh: 防晒衣项目演示快照：按 7 项子任务的交付核对记录汇总。上线准备仍有待收口项，数据复盘需等 9/15 上线后的成交数据，项目预计 9/16 完成。任务状态保留用户设置。
en: Sun-protection campaign demo snapshot: aggregated from 7 subtask delivery reviews. Launch preparation has open items; analytics must wait for sales data after the 9/15 launch. Project completion is forecast for 9/16. The user-set task status is preserved.

zh: 演示交付节点：上线成交数据接入，看板完成首轮核对；退款归因与复盘待次日收口。
en: Demo delivery milestone: launch sales data connected and dashboard initially checked; refund attribution and retrospective close the next day.
